basic_info.description: Set on a charming, tree-lined street, grandeur & intimacy inform the airy, fresh architecture of this thoughtfully designed, modernist residence. Taken to the studs & revisioned with the help of John Lum Architecture & Studio Jyo Interiors, the hardworking floorplan offers easygoing indoor-outdoor livability, a deep level garden & stunnning view deck. Clad in vertical grain white oak millwork, the elegant living room is open to a custom library, oak hardwood flooring anchoring the space. The sleek, professionally equipped Bertazzoni kitchen, dining, & family room have outdoor access & stunning southern outlooks. The soaring open stair is a central core of light, creating a luminous connectedness from sky-lit upper-level suite & expansive deck to the levels below, southeastern views bring glorious natural light & an embrace of lush greenery. At garden level are 3 bedrooms & 2 luxe baths, mud room, laundry, interior access to garage & storage.  Custom interior design, exquisite lighting & stone work, smart house features, & polished craftsmanship offer turn-key quality & a one-of-a-kind sophisticated modernity. Well located between Glen park & Noe Valley, this sublime residence offers access to Glen Park Canyon & Rec Center, shopping & dining in the village of Glen Park, BART/FWY
